summary: Frontend-only review of the new AI Operations Center foundation (StatusCard + OutboundDialerStatusCard + OpsCenterPage). All 11 acceptance criteria from the review_request PASS. No bugs found. The component is genuinely reusable: adding a 2nd card requires literally one line in OpsCenterPage's `cards` array + one new ~50-line component file.
tests_executed: Login as test@example.com / Test123! via /login -> redirected into /app
Navigated to /app/ops -> h1 'AI Operations Center' rendered (data-testid=ops-center-title)
Grid classList confirmed: 'grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4 lg:gap-5' (matches responsive contract for mobile/tablet/desktop)

SAFE state: ran outbound_selftest.py + removed OUTBOUND_DISABLED -> card rendered with data-status='safe', badge='SAFE', reason='Self-test passed and no kill switch present — outbound dialing allowed.', kill-switch='absent', can-live-dial='yes', last-self-test='35s ago', self-test-result='passed'
Refresh button fired a new GET /api/admin/outbound-status (network interception: count 2 -> 3 on click)

Sidebar: 'Ops Center' nav entry with Activity icon present at /app/ops, marked active (highlighted in screenshot)

Code review of StatusCard.jsx: props {title, icon, fetchStatus, intervalMs=30000, testId, helpHref} ✓, handles {safe,warn,down,unknown} ✓, formatRelativeTime exported (Xs/Xm/Xh ago) ✓, catches fetchStatus errors with data-testid='${testId}-error' ✓, setInterval + document.hidden check ✓, visibilitychange refresh on tab refocus ✓, every interactive/info element has data-testid ✓

Code review of OpsCenterPage.jsx: comment block lists all 7 future engine cards (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Twilio, Prospecting, Campaign Engine, UniversalBrain, System Health) ✓, `cards` array with single outbound entry — adding a new card is trivial ✓

Secrets scan: grep -rE 'api[_-]?key|secret|token|sk-|TWILIO_|ELEVENLABS_|OPENAI' /app/frontend/src — no hardcoded values; only session_token reads from localStorage and standard auth Bearer headers (expected). Frontend uses only process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL ✓

Backend smoke-check (not full pytest, per scope): curl $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/admin/outbound-status returns valid JSON with the 7 expected keys: kill_switch_present, outbound_disabled, last_selftest_at, last_selftest_passed, last_selftest_report_path, can_live_dial, reason ✓
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR (non-blocking): In dev/StrictMode the initial mount fires fetchStatus twice (observed 2 requests before any Refresh click). Harmless in prod build, but if you want strict idempotency consider an AbortController in StatusCard's effect.

MINOR (non-blocking): StatusCard's polling interval is fixed at mount; intervalMs changes after mount won't restart the timer cleanly because the same `refresh` callback depends on fetchStatus. Acceptable for current usage (intervalMs is a constant per card).
OPTIONAL: helpHref is rendered but no cards pass it yet; consider linking it to a runbook (e.g., /app/docs/ops/outbound) once docs exist.

OPTIONAL: The badge label 'UNVERIFIED' (used when neither can_live_dial nor kill_switch nor failed selftest match) is a 5th label not enumerated in the test contract's {SAFE,UNVERIFIED,DISABLED} set — current contract DOES include UNVERIFIED so this is consistent; just noting that StatusCard's defaultLabel for 'warn' is 'DEGRADED' while OutboundDialerStatusCard overrides to 'UNVERIFIED'. Both are valid since label is overridable.

context_for_next_testing_agent: StatusCard contract is solid; future engine cards (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Twilio, etc.) only need a new component in /app/frontend/src/components/cards/ and one append to OpsCenterPage.jsx `cards` array. Their fetchStatus must return {status, label, reason, metrics:[{label,value}]}. Test the same way: assert data-status, badge text, metric testids, and Refresh button fires the network call.
